name: open-interpreter
label: Open Interpreter
install: release tarball from openinterpreter/openinterpreter rust-v0.0.58 (see the matrix.yml install step)
runnable_note: Plain-start matrix client (cli_plain.py); the Rust Open Interpreter tracks Codex (no pipx/npm package) — install is the pinned GitHub release tarball (docs: openinterpreter.com/docs/terminal/providers)

files.{{HOME}}/.openinterpreter/config.toml:
model = "{{MODEL}}"
model_provider = "proxyllm"

[model_providers.proxyllm]
name = "PROxyLLM"
base_url = "{{BASE_URL}}/v1"
env_key = "PROXYLLM_CLIENT_KEY"
wire_api = "chat"
